Name: NPC furniture - Penny's yellow and oak recolors
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
Update: The textures in this mod have now been added to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13064]NPC furniture and wallpaper[/url]

[u]Instructions:[/u]
Extract into mods folder.
Retexture items using paint bucket you can buy at Robin's

[u]Tips and Tricks:[/u]
Some of the end tables will look cut off because you need to flip them and place them next to each other
Spouse room in the screenshot is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6617]Toshinori[/url]. The children are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6320]Eri[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8977]Izuku[/url] from My Hero Academia.
See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984]Asterisk's Alternative Textures tools retexture[/url]﻿ for a video on how to use AT tools in-game.
